verdict.rationale: A federal tax payment platform could plausibly publish official SDKs or APIs, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no official SDK. The only software channel documented is the Batch Provider Software, which the evidence describes as "not an API." It is a separate, adjacent tool rather than a developer SDK. Probes for OpenAPI specs at the candidate paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
